title: Propagate inherited base properies to consumer scenes
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

If the user updates properties of a base scene or inherited scene, any scenes referencing the inherited scene do not reflect the changes until closed and re-opened.

**Steps to Replicate**

I create main.tscn.
main.tscn is empty.

I create base.tscn.
I add base.gd to the root node of base.tscn.

Contents of base.gd is:
```gdscript
extends Node3D

@export var my_number : int = 50
```

In the file system explorer, I right click base.tscn.
I choose "New Inherited Scene".
I immediately save this new scene as inherited.tscn.

Now I have main.tscn, base.tscn, and inherited.tscn open still. 

I add inherited.tscn under the root of main.tscn.

I saved all the open scenes.

Now I'm watching the inspector for inherited.tscn inside of main.tscn.

I update the value of my_number in the inspector of base.tscn (not in the code).
I save the updated base.tscn.
I check inherited.tscn's inspector, it has the new value.
I chec main.tscn, it still displays 50.

But wait, there's more. 

I close main.tscn. 
I open main.tscn.

The value is now up to date! 

That value should have propagated out to all open scenes.


- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/43032

## Additional information

**AI Disclosure**, I used Claude Opus 4.7 to perform the investigation, devise a plan for a fix, and implement the fix.

I did it in one prompt using Claude Code CLI.
This is literally the prompt I used:
```
This code base is the Godot Engine.
I need you to fix a bug for me.
I will handle all building and validation of your work.

Godot has a bug with propagating out inherited scene values.

I create main.tscn.
main.tscn is empty.

I create base.tscn.
I add base.gd to the root node of base.tscn.

Contents of base.gd is:
\```gdscript
extends Node3D

@export var my_number : int = 50
\```

In the file system explorer, I right click base.tscn.
I choose "New Inherited Scene".
I immediately save this new scene as inherited.tscn.

Now I have main.tscn, base.tscn, and inherited.tscn open still. 

I add inherited.tscn under the root of main.tscn.

I saved all the open scenes.

Now I'm watching the inspector for inherited.tscn inside of main.tscn.

I update the value of my_number in the inspector of base.tscn (not in the code).
I save the updated base.tscn.
I check inherited.tscn's inspector, it has the new value.
I chec main.tscn, it still displays 50.

But wait, there's more. 

I close main.tscn. 
I open main.tscn.

The value is now up to date! 

That value should have propagated out to all open scenes.

Please do a code review and ensure that these values are propogating out, for all scenes.
We could have deeply nested inherited scenes... should propagate for all non-modified values in the chain.
```
